scope_notes: Passenger-km and tonne-km are different services; do not add them or convert without explicit mass/load assumptions.
Road/water cover registered commercial vehicles/vessels; road passenger is not private-car travel or all national mobility.

Rail excludes military and non-public dedicated lines; civil aviation covers domestic-registered carriers including domestic,HongKong/Macao/Taiwan and international operations, not a territorial fuel boundary.
Pipeline includes crude/refinedoil,naturalgas andothergas, not directly energy consumed transporting them.
NBS2025 is retrospective data. Precise public availability of each historical revision not established. Given realized activity is not an investor forecast.
